name: DUCKVADER buyTokens per-address cap bypass
summary: DUCKVADER.buyTokens() handed out tokens against a per-address limit only, with no payment tied to the amount, so the attacker looped fresh helper contracts to claim the allowance many times over and dumped the result on Uniswap V2.

loss.notes: Migrated from legacy lossUsd/lossOther. The legacy corpus did not consistently distinguish gross from net loss or record valuation provenance.

sources.note: onchain review: DUCKVADER 0xaa8f35183478B8EcEd5619521Ac3Eb3886E98c56 created 2025-03-10T14:05:21Z by 0xdb051b9e11261206181d4f486fc0d7c6ba51937e, not the attack-tx sender 0x2383a550e40a61b41a89da6b91d8a4a2452270d0; no EIP-1967 events, 18 hours old. The PoC deploys a fresh AttackContract2 per buy, confirming the limit is per address. ~5 ETH x $1,914.19 at the incident timestamp (DefiLlama) = $9,571.
